thread:
alice_support: heads up — ACME reported ~200ms->1.8s spikes and duplicate billing traces. They see requests flip between us-west1 and eu-west1 within the same user flow. Suspect client retry/hedging.
ben_engineer: got a repro? any request_ids or logs?
alice_support: customer pasted this snippet from their SDK logs: `requestId=rc_01F... region=us-west1 status=200 latency=180ms` then 40ms later `requestId=rc_01F... region=eu-west1 status=200 latency=40ms` — same request id in their app logs but two server-side endpoints.
carol_sre: that looks like hedged/parallel retries. If their SDK sends hedged requests to multiple regions and we charge per processed request, they can get double billing and cross-region latency.
dave_devrel: can we confirm whether our routing respects an idempotency key or request-id header and drops duplicates?
routing-bot: note: server currently treats each incoming request as independent unless x-redwood-request-id header is present and matches existing in dedupe cache (TTL 5s).
ben_engineer: customer says they use the JS SDK with `hedgedRequests: true, timeoutMs: 120` and no explicit request-id. Default SDK behavior is to generate an internal UUID per hedged attempt rather than a shared id — looks like a bug.
alice_support: repro steps from customer: 1) SDK config: `hedgedRequests: true, hedgeTimeoutMs: 60, globalTimeoutMs: 150` 2) call `client.generate()` 3) observe two inflight requests across regions and both billed. They have a mini repro app I can share.
carol_sre: can you paste the minimal repro here? we should try to run in our env.
dave_devrel: customer attached code: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ regionPreference: 'nearest', hedgedRequests: true, hedgeTimeoutMs: 60 });
await client.text.generate({ prompt: 'test', maxTokens: 32 });
```
ben_engineer: quick internal test: if no shared request-id header, our server sees two distinct requests and charges both. Also traces show different routing decisions: first attempt routed to us-west1, second hedged to eu-west1 because of slight delay in route table.
carol_sre: action: short-term mitigation = ask customer to set `requestId`/`idempotencyKey` header in SDK calls (we can add param) to get dedupe on server. Medium-term = change SDK to generate a single request-id for hedged attempts. Long-term = enhance server dedupe window and make dedupe lookup by a combination of request-id + user-id for reserved accounts.
alice_support: customer is urgent — reporting elevated costs today. I proposed disabling hedgedRequests as temporary fix. They asked for a clear repro so they can test.
dave_devrel: I can patch the JS SDK this week to attach `x-redwood-request-id` across hedged attempts. PR will include tests and config flag `shareRequestIdBetweenHedges: true` (default true).
ben_engineer: runtime note — increasing dedupe cache TTL from 5s->10s should cover most hedged windows, but memory impact needs verification. I'll open an infra ticket.
carol_sre: also need observability: add a route-level metric for duplicate request hits (increments when dedupe cache prevents double processing). put on console dashboard.
alice_support: customer responded: "happy to disable hedging if you think that's best; can you confirm we won't lose latency benefits if we disable?"
dave_devrel: explain tradeoff: hedges reduce tail latency but can double cost if dedupe isn't in place. Recommend one of: a) set `hedgedRequests=false` until SDK patch/tenants mitigations land, b) add explicit requestId in client, or c) enable dedicated region pinning `regionPreference: 'local-only'`.
ben_engineer: repro logs I collected (internal): ```
[1887654301] rc_01Fabc region=us-west1 processing-start
[1887654301] rc_01Fdef region=eu-west1 processing-start
[1887654302] rc_01Fabc processed 200 tokens
[1887654302] rc_01Fdef processed 200 tokens
```
carol_sre: assigned: ben -> runtime ticket for dedupe TTL; dave -> SDK patch; me -> console metric and billing guardrail check.
alice_support: customer asked for ETA on SDK patch and server-side guardrail. Can we give dates?
dave_devrel: ETA SDK patch PR by EOD + release in next minor (24 - two days). Server dedupe TTL change needs review — estimate 3 business days for safe rollout. console metric as a tile in 5 business days.
ben_engineer: noted — I'll also backfill a temporary billing report for ACME showing duplicated charges and credits pending review.
carol_sre: follow-ups: 1) get customer repro app, 2) run internal repro against staging with hedges enabled, 3) ship SDK patch, 4) server TTL bump behind feature flag, 5) update support KB.
alice_support: thanks all. tagging @carol_sre for priority. :eyes:
dave_devrel: I'll post a short DevRel note explaining how to set requestId and hedge config. :memo:
alice_support: closing loop — customer will disable hedges for now and test SDK patch when released. will update once they confirm cost impact. :thumbsup:
